title: Oven Roasted Japanese Sloe Berries Wrap
description: A smoky and velvety Japanese dish featuring sloe berries and ssam wrap, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together sesame oil, rice vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sloe berries to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Spread the sloe berries on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the sloe berries are roasting, toast the ssam wrap sheets by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing a few roasted sloe berries on a toasted ssam wrap sheet and sprinkling with toasted sesame seeds if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
